data.name: PawnIOInstallPrompt
data.value:
CPU and GPU sensors (clock, temperature, voltage) require the PawnIO driver, which is not installed.
Install it now? It will be downloaded from its official source (pawnio.eu, by namazso), the digital signature will be verified, and setup runs silently in the background.
If you skip this, those sensors will show "No Value" until you install it later.
